items.name: Competency Assessment
items.description: Assess learner or workforce competencies using structured assessments and measurable competency outcomes.

items.name: Skill Gap Analysis
items.description: Identify the difference between current competency and required competency for a role, program or learning objective.

items.name: Personalized Learning
items.description: Use competency gaps to guide learning paths, courses and relevant learning resources.

items.name: Training Management
items.description: Support courses, learning resources, assessments, training activities and learner progress.

items.name: Competency Tracking
items.description: Track competency development and improvement over time.

items.name: Certification
items.description: Support competency certification and certificate history.

items.name: Analytics & Reporting
items.description: Provide competency, learning, training and workforce analytics.
